summary.zh-TW: 按 Upload：進度環和長條一起前進，速度忽快忽慢像真的網路；完成時百分比淡出，環變綠、打勾彈出來。
summary.en: Press Upload: the ring and bar advance together at an uneven, realistic pace; on completion the percentage fades, the ring turns green and a tick pops in.

text.zh-TW: 進度只存在一個數字裡，環、長條、百分比文字都在 onUpdate 裡依這個數字重畫，三者永遠同步。
text.en: Progress lives in one number; the ring, bar and percentage all redraw from it in onUpdate, so they always agree.

text.zh-TW: 用 DrawSVG 把圓圈畫出百分比那麼長。SVG 轉 -90°，進度才會從 12 點鐘方向開始。
text.en: DrawSVG draws the circle to the percentage. The SVG is rotated -90° so progress starts at 12 o’clock.

text.zh-TW: 假的上傳分好幾段、每段速度不同，看起來比一路等速更真實；真實情況是依伺服器回報的進度更新 p。
text.en: The fake upload runs in uneven steps, which looks more real than a constant speed; in production, p follows the server’s reported progress.

text.zh-TW: 完成時的綠色交給 CSS class，GSAP 只負責打勾彈出。顏色留在 CSS 裡，亮暗模式才會正確。
text.en: The green completion colour is a CSS class; GSAP only pops the tick. Keeping colours in CSS keeps light and dark mode correct.
